name: team_planning_rebase_preview
description: Preview updating a Team Planning plan the caller is in to today (a UTC day), before team_planning_rebase_plan does it. `drift` is what the update takes in: the from, to, changes and names that team_planning_drift gives for the same base, in the same shape. For the baseline (scenario_id equal to the plan_id) and each scenario, it counts the planned changes reading done, pending and conflicting, as team_planning_status reads them. Once the base is today a conflicting change would read pending, so `conflicts` names each one, by the scenario it reads conflicting in, subject_id, facet and change_id: the update records them afresh, and status keeps them conflicting. `names` gives each conflict's subject a name, as team_planning_status names it. `starts` names the first step whose start the update moves, with its start now (starts_on) and on today (will_start_on); a first step that starts after today keeps its start, and the days before it stay as today. Pass base_on to team_planning_rebase_plan. Refused when the plan already stands on today or on a day still to come, when the plan is updated while the preview reads it, when the first step would end before today, naming it, when the plan is archived, and, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.
